title: fix(ui): Skill Workshop off state hides errors and loses focus
body:
## What Problem This Solves

A UX audit of the Skill Workshop off state from #192766 found five problems:

- The off panel never got its intended layout. `.settings-group.oc-settings-group { display: block }` overrode `.sw-empty { display: grid }`. The wand icon sat beside "Skill Workshop is off" instead of above it, and an error banner touched the bottom of the button.
- A failed enable showed raw Gateway text. On a real Gateway with plugins globally disabled it reads `plugin "skill-workshop" could not be enabled (plugins disabled)`. A plugin that fails to load shows `Plugin operation failed during activate: plugin load failed: … Gateway generation 3: replacement not applied.`
- A failed plugin check said "Couldn’t load the Workshop. Try again." plus the raw message, describing the wrong failure.
- Keyboard focus fell to `<body>` as soon as the button turned busy (`disabled`), and stayed there after the Workshop loaded.
- The page relies on the Gateway's `plugins.changed` broadcast (sent `dropIfSlow`) to load the Workshop. If a successful enable is never published to this client, the button stayed disabled on "Turning on…" with no way forward.

## User Impact

- The off, missing and failed panels stack icon, title, text, action and error with consistent spacing. The library's own empty state uses the same rule and gains its intended spacing.
- Enable failures read "Couldn’t turn on Skill Workshop. Try again." Check failures read "Couldn’t check whether Skill Workshop is on." with Retry. The raw, redacted Gateway text sits under "Show details", using the existing `ErrorDetails` from #192057.
- While the plugin turns on, the button is `aria-disabled`/`aria-busy` but keeps focus. When the Workshop loads in place, focus moves to the Workshop panel.
- If the Workshop hasn't arrived 15 s after a successful enable, the page rechecks `plugins.list` once. If the plugin is on, it says "Skill Workshop is on. Reload to open it." with a Reload button. If it's still off, the button comes back.

## Evidence

| | Before (main) | After |
|---|---|---|
| Off state | ![before](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7f147466-2ee9-4376-a740-079408a57dfc) | ![after](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a45d6e56-4d5a-4550-972a-01689936f855) |
| Enable failure | ![before](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fef51836-a314-4f0b-883f-bf5d0fc350a6) | ![after](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/72bb6b88-1bb4-4e1c-b50b-42ccdbbccae9) |
| Check failure | ![before](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/44526d46-4a01-44ec-b98c-8603876e4a85) | ![after](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1c90458f-aa23-4b55-8db5-43b4d5eb0a2d) |

Real Gateway with `plugins.enabled: false`, before: ![real](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f36fce50-cd82-4438-8e3b-a3dadef34b6f)
Phone, dark, after: ![after phone](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fac58afc-e60e-47a9-83ae-dc18418facfb)

Audit method:
- Mocked-Gateway matrix: 7 states × 375/768/1280/1440 × light/dark, with axe-core 4.14 on each state at 1280. No axe violations before or after.
- Keyboard walk; layout-shift observer arriving from the Plugins tab (0 shifts at 375 and 1280). Built-Gateway runs on main for plugin on, off, globally disabled, and failing to load (entry file replaced with a throw).
- Pixel diff of the on-state Plugins, Skills and Workshop pages against the pre-move build (`f517164`): Skills and Workshop identical, Plugins differs only in the subtitle copy from #192266.
- Real enable: click to loaded Workshop in 814 ms, existing learned skills intact.

Tests:
- `skill-workshop-page` 23/23. The four new or changed off-state tests fail on main's code: focusable busy button, summarized enable failure with collapsed details, reload fallback, summarized check failure.
- The real-Gateway e2e now asserts focus lands on the Workshop panel after loading in place: 3/3 runs, both suites.
- Also run: `skills-page` 28/28, `plugins-hub-header` 2/2, Workshop layout browser 3/3, `learning-session` 3/3. `tsgo:ui` is clean apart from main's existing `browser-panel-render.tsx` error. oxlint, stylelint, `check:control-ui-controllers` and `ui:i18n:verify` pass.

Test lines: `config/test-lines-allocations/skill-workshop-off-state-ux.txt` allocates this PR's 54 added lines. Main is separately 7 lines over its ceiling.

## Not changed here

- Plugins globally disabled: the page still offers the button. `plugins.list` doesn't report the global switch, and the Control UI has no setting for it, so the right message is a product decision.
- The non-admin off text still says "Turn it on…" above "An admin can turn it on from Plugins."
